Population increased in Thanet

The estimated population of Thanet in 2024 was 142,691 usual residents, a rise of 1.2% since 2023.

This meant that Thanet's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Thanet increased by 1.4%.

Over this slightly longer period, Thanet was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Thanet

The average (median) age fell to 44.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Thanet has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Thanet is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Thanet's population of 142,691 usual residents was made up of:

  • 25,458 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.8%)
  • 83,191 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58.3%)
  • 34,042 people aged 65 years and over, (23.9%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Thanet has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (23.9% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Thanet, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Thanet
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Thanet, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 608 people (-0.4%). In total, there were 1,260 births and 1,868 deaths in Thanet.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,328 (0.9%). There were 6,746 people entering the area and 5,418 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Thanet's population of 926 (0.7%) as a result of 1,395 people entering the area and 469 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Thanet was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Thanet in mid-2023 is 141,049.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 239 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 371 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 610 people.
